svg.data-chapters: [{"t":0.3,"text":"The speaker cone pushes the air in front of it"},{"t":4,"text":"Each bit of air only rocks to and fro"},{"t":8,"text":"but the squeeze passes along: that is the sound"}]

svg.title: How sound travels through air

g.data-info: The cone moves out and back many times a second, squeezing and then stretching the air in front of it.
Air. Every particle stays near where it started; it passes each push on to its neighbour.

g.data-info: The squeezes arrive one after another and push the microphone in the same rhythm as the cone.
